description: Migration class for fixing nullable constraints on address-related columns in the Orders table within Entity Framework Core migrations.

classes.name: FixShipToAddress
classes.description: Entity Framework Core migration class that modifies the nullability of address fields in the Orders table.

methods.name: Up
methods.description: Applies the migration, setting address fields as non-nullable with default empty string values.

methods.name: Down
methods.description: Reverts the migration, restoring address fields to nullable.
